question: In 2019, who was selected as the President of the World Bank for a five-year term?
solution:
The correct answer is **__David Malpass.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **David R. Malpass** was selected as **13th President of the World Bank Group by its Board of Executive Directors on April 5, 2019.**
 
• **Mr. Malpass** previously served as **Under Secretary of the Treasury for International Affairs for the United States.**
 
• He was a senior economic adviser to **US President Donald Trump during his 2016 election campaign.**
 
• **Malpass **succeeds **Jim Yong-Kim**, who stepped down on **February 1 to join an investment firm.**
 
• Mr. Malpass represented the United States in international settings, including the **G-7 and G-20 Deputy Finance Ministerial, World Bank- IMF Spring and Annual Meetings, and meetings of the Financial Stability Board, the Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development, and the Overseas Private** **Investment Corporation.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 

 
 

 **Jim Yong Kim**
 
 
 
• **Jim Yong Kim is, also known as Kim Yong, an American physician**, and anthropologist who served as the 12th President of the World Bank from 2012 to 2019.
 
• **On January 7, 2019**, he announced that he would step down effective February 1, 2019.
 
 
 
 

 **Raghuram Rajan**
 
 
 
• He is an** Indian economist and 23rd Governor of the RBI.**
 
• He is also the author of the book **'I Do What I Do'.**
